name: Anarch Thaumaturgical Rituals — Intermediate — Detect the Hidden Observer

system.description: Intended as a companion to Banish Big Brother, this ritual alerts the caster whenever supernatural powers are used to spy on her, though unlike its cousin it does not block such surveillance or reveal the observer's identity or location. To cast it, the caster drains a Blood Trait into a fire fueled by her own personal documents or recordings, then anoints her forehead, eyes and ears with the resulting ashes, leaving faint telltale marks. Until the next sunrise, the recipient feels a sharp pain in her eyes, ears or forehead whenever another individual actively spies on her with a supernatural power (such as Heightened Senses or Telepathy reading her mind), and learns the general type of surveillance used. It does not detect powers that merely conceal (such as Obfuscate used to eavesdrop without any special sensory boost) nor conventional eavesdropping.
